briefTitle: Safety and Preliminary Effectiveness of BNT317, an Investigational Therapy for Advanced Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have at least one measurable lesion based on RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematologic and organ function, as defined in the protocol.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ and hematologic function refers to protocol definitions without explicit lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have had an adequate treatment washout period before randomization/enrollment, as defined in the protocol.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout period is protocol-defined and variable.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part B1 only: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of locally advanced, unresectable (not amenable to curative surgery or radiation therapy) or metastatic clear cell RCC (including those with sarcomatoid features).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This trial is a basket study for advanced solid tumors with sub-cohorts (RCC, GC/GEJC, and NSCLC), and Part B1 specifies renal cell carcinoma.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part B2 only: Histologically and/or cytologically documented metastatic adenocarcinoma and squamous carcinoma of GC/GEJC.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Part B2 is specific to GC/GEJC rather than NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part B3 only: Have advanced (i.e., metastatic or locally recurrent where local therapy with curative intent is not possible) non-squamous or squamous NSCLC.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Part B3 covers NSCLC with multiple complex prior lines and biomarker rules that cannot be reduced to a single standard histology_in or prior_therapy check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have any of the following CNS metastases: Untreated brain metastases that are symptomatic or large (e.g., greater than 2 cm). Treated CNS metastases who are not neurologically stable or on steroids or anticonvulsants within 2 weeks before initiating IMP of this study. Brain metastases treated with radiotherapy that are not confirmed stable by magnetic resonance imaging or contrast-enhanced computer tomography 4 weeks after radiotherapy. Participants with known leptomeningeal metastases.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The brain metastases criteria include nuanced conditions such as size, symptom status, steroid/anticonvulsant use, and imaging confirmation timelines that do not fit a simple allowedBrainMets category.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received any of the following therapies or drugs within the noted time intervals prior to study treatment: Any prior treatment which inhibits cluster of differentiation 39. Vaccination with live attenuated vaccine(s) within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of IMP. Any investigational product within 4 weeks or 5 half lives... Systemic cytotoxic chemotherapy, immunotherapy within 3 weeks... Radiation therapy... Palliative radiotherapy... Systemic corticosteroids...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: These are specific washout windows and prior drug exclusions that are too complex for simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum Age: 18 Years

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Applies only to part B1 clear cell RCC, which is a different cancer type than NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Applies only to part B2 GC/GEJC, which is a different cancer type than NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Untreated brain metastases that are symptomatic or large (e.g., greater than 2 cm).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Systemic corticosteroids (at a dosage greater than 10 mg/day of prednisone or an equivalent dose of other corticosteroids) within 2 weeks prior to the first dose of IMP.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Corticosteroid dosage and washout rule is not covered by a typed check kind.
